description: T1: a rotation claim judged by a reader that holds no record of rotated_from (the rotation-claim kind: rotation_sig null, by an unrelated key, by the record key, by the previous record's rotation key, S + L, moved from another record: each bad-rotation; countersigned by rotated_from: ok), and the rotation-key path, taken only with the previous record held (the rotation kind).
